capabilities: Ingest URLs, GitHub repos, and other sources into an immutable raw/ layer
Synthesize structured wiki pages with LLM-generated Key Findings and Relevance sections
Chat with the knowledge base through the bundled Gryphon sidebar panel
Organize, merge, soft-delete, and restore KB pages with verb-driven kb commands
Lint the KB and auto-fix data inconsistencies
extras: Desktop-only (terminal commands and Python engine need a local filesystem). Python dependency is tracked for removal in the 1.2 milestone. Early release candidates available via BRAT. Full terminal-only kb commands require cloning the upstream polleoai/athena repo as a vault. README documents known limitations: bot-blocked sites may capture challenge pages, slow first capture on Linux, and prompt-history flush issues across restarts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically capture web sources, synthesize them into cross-referenced knowledge pages with an LLM, and query that knowledge base conversationally.

relations.evidence: Athena bundles Gryphon. Talk to your knowledge base through the chat panel in your sidebar
use the Obsidian Web Clipper extension to drop a clipping into <vault>/clippings/

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini API key (or local claude CLI)
Python 3.10+ for the wiki page builder

summary: LLM-powered second-brain plugin that ingests URLs into a raw layer, synthesizes structured wiki pages, and lets you chat with your vault via bundled Gryphon.
